title: DZE LIKE RZA Shares Latest Hit “First Time”
htmlContent:
Phoenix-based rapper DZE LIKE RZA has just released “First Time,” a track that immediately stands out. From the first listen, you can tell this song pays homage to the golden age of hip-hop while bringing something fresh and personal to the table.

The beat grabs you right away. There’s a heavy piano line that feels like a nod to Timbaland’s early work, paired with an infectious tempo that gets your head nodding. It’s the kind of production that feels familiar and exciting, perfectly setting the stage for DZE’s storytelling.

Speaking of storytelling, DZE LIKE RZA knows how to weave a tale. “First Time” dives into a personal story about a youthful crush on an older woman, a scenario many can relate to. The way he lays out his feelings—mixing hope, frustration, and a touch of humor—makes the track incredibly engaging.

DZE’s voice is another standout feature. His delivery has a gritty, raw quality that reminds you of hip-hop legends like ODB and DMX. Yet, he manages to maintain a unique sound that sets him apart. His vocals are filled with emotion, making you feel every word he’s rapping. It’s a voice that commands attention and holds it from start to finish.

One of the most impressive aspects of “First Time” is how it balances introspection with high energy. The beat is lively and engaging, making it perfect for a party playlist, but the lyrics offer depth and a personal touch that invites closer listening. It’s a track that works on multiple levels, whether you’re looking to vibe out or dig into the story behind the music.

DZE LIKE RZA is clearly an artist with a lot to offer. “First Time” isn’t just a great single; it’s a statement of intent from a rapper who’s ready to make his mark. His ability to blend classic influences with his own experiences and style is what makes this track so compelling. It’s a refreshing reminder of what hip-hop can be—honest, relatable, and rhythmically irresistible.

In a world full of disposable tracks, “First Time” is a song that sticks. DZE LIKE RZA has crafted a piece of music that’s as thoughtful as it is catchy, making it a must-listen for anyone who appreciates the art of hip-hop. If you haven’t checked it out yet, now’s the time. DZE LIKE RZA is an artist on the rise, and “First Time” is just the beginning.
